name: DESH Hails a Taxi and Begins a Journey
description: DESH arrives at the location and steps to the curb, raising a hand to signal a passing taxi. A cab pulls over, and DESH opens the door and gets inside. The taxi drives away, carrying DESH down the city street.
related_events: DESH arrives and hails a taxi

name: Passing Through Customs
description: The characters arrive at the port of entry and proceed to the customs area. They present their documents to the officer, who inspects the papers and asks a few questions. After a brief wait, the officer stamps their forms and allows them to move forward. They collect their belongings and walk through the checkpoint, entering the country.
related_events: Characters pass through customs upon arrival

name: Desh Heads to the Petit Socco
description: Desh walks through the streets, moving steadily closer to the Petit Socco. His path winds through the narrow alleys, his steps firm and directed, as he makes his way toward the square.
related_events: Desh moves through the streets toward the Petit Socco

name: Nicky Ascends Through Hallways
description: Nicky moves through one hallway, then another, ascending continuously through a series of connected corridors.
related_events: Nicky moves through multiple hallways ascending continuously

name: Nicky Waits for a Coded Response at the Café
description: Nicky sits at the café, phone in hand. The call connects. She asks, 'Code in?' There is no reply. She asks again. Only the sound of traffic comes through the line. She looks around, then stays silent, still holding the phone.
related_events: Nicky waits at the café and receives a silent phone call

name: Desh Notices a Map Alert on His Phone
description: Desh looks down at his cellphone as it emits a beeping sound. The screen displays a map, illuminated and active, signaling an incoming alert.
related_events: Desh notices cellphone alert with map display

name: Bourne Spots Desh and Moves Toward Him
description: Bourne sees Desh further up the street and begins moving in his direction.
related_events: Bourne spots Desh further up the street
Bourne moves toward Desh's location

name: DESH Makes a Silent Call While Heading to Petit Socco
description: DESH walks toward Petit Socco, holding a mobile phone. As he moves, he places a call without speaking, keeping the line open in silence.
related_events: DESH makes a silent call while moving towards Petit Socco

name: Desh Takes the Scooter and Leaves
description: Desh pushes the scooter out from where it was parked, steps onto it, and rides away.
related_events: Desh takes the scooter out

name: Vosen Orders Investigation of Deviating Asset
description: The asset veered off its expected course. Vosen turned to the technician and said, 'Find out why.' The technician began checking the systems immediately.
related_events: Asset deviates from expected course
Vosen orders investigation into asset deviation

name: Bourne and Nicky Cross the Strait by Ferry
description: Bourne and Nicky board a ferry in Gibraltar and travel across the Strait of Gibraltar to Morocco. They remain together throughout the journey, moving quietly through the vessel and keeping a low profile. The ferry sails through open water, reaching the Moroccan coast as the sun rises on the horizon.
related_events: Bourne and Nicky travel by ferry from Gibraltar to Morocco

name: Bourne and Nicky Escape in Volkswagen Golf
description: The agents dropped their guns and raised their hands. Bourne and Nicky turned the corner, moved quickly to Nicky's Volkswagen Golf, got inside, and drove away.
related_events: Agents surrender by dropping their weapons
Bourne and Nicky flee in a Volkswagen Golf

name: Police Confront Agents at Gunpoint
description: Four police officers leap out of their vehicle, drawing their weapons and shouting 'Manos Arriba!' at the agents. More sirens wail in the distance as a third police car arrives, followed by a fourth, surrounding the scene with flashing lights and officers maintaining their aim.
related_events: Spanish police officers confront agents with weapons drawn
Additional police vehicles arrive at the scene

name: Vosen Orders Fund Release and Technician Contacts Daniels
description: Vosen gave the order to release the funds from the bank. Shortly afterward, a technician placed a call to Daniels.
related_events: Vosen instructs to release funds from the bank
A technician calls Daniels

name: Desh Retrieves Scooter and Departs
description: Desh unlocks a storage unit, steps inside, and comes out with a scooter. He mounts it, starts the engine, and drives away.
related_events: Desh opens lock-up and retrieves scooter
Desh drives off on scooter

name: Receive Call and Leave for Bank
description: Daniels answers the phone. A bank officer from the Bank of Tangier, speaking in French with subtitles, tells him that his funds are now available. Daniels hangs up and leaves the room.
related_events: Bank officer informs Daniels about fund availability
Daniels departs after receiving phone call

name: Vosen and Landy React to Police Arrival
description: Vosen and Landy are watching a scene unfold when two Madrid police cars come around the corner the wrong way, tires screeching as they halt abruptly. Vosen reacts immediately.
related_events: Madrid police cars arrive abruptly while Vosen and Landy observe
Vosen reacts to the sudden arrival of police cars

name: Vosen Retrieves Top Secret File
description: Noah Vosen approaches a secure safe and speaks into a voiceprint microphone, stating his name. He then places his thumb on a biometric scanner. The safe door unlocks and swings open. Vosen reaches inside and removes a file labeled 'Top Secret'.
related_events: Vosen accesses secure safe using voice and thumbprint authentication
Vosen retrieves top secret file from safe

name: Bourne Fails to Call as Police Close In
description: Bourne picks up the phone to make a call but hears a busy signal. He listens for a moment, recognizing the tone. Outside, footsteps approach—police officers are drawing nearer to his location. He sets the phone down and moves quickly toward the exit.
related_events: Bourne hears busy signal on phone line
Police officers approach Bourne's location

name: Desh Defuses Bomb While Nicky Calls Out
description: Desh kneels beside a bomb, carefully cutting wires and adjusting components. A sudden voice breaks the silence—Nicky calls out from somewhere off-camera. Desh pauses, glances up briefly, then returns to the device without responding.
related_events: Desh works on defusing a bomb
Nicky calls out to Desh from off-camera

name: Desh parks his Vespa and walks through the square
description: Desh steered his Vespa through a dense flow of bicycles, weaving across the square until he reached the corner of Rue des Chrétiens. He parked the scooter there and continued on foot, moving through the crowded square amid a steady stream of cyclists and pedestrians.
related_events: Desh parks Vespa at corner of Rue des Chrétiens
Desh walks through crowded square

name: Desh Receives Target Photos and Spots Bourne on Vespa
description: Desh rides his Vespa through the city. As he travels, he receives new information, including photographs of Bourne and Nicky. He looks at the images, then glances at his rearview mirror and sees Bourne behind him.
related_events: Desh receives target information while riding his Vespa
Desh spots Bourne in his rearview mirror

name: DESH Cuts Off Nicky
description: DESH arrives at the building steps and looks up, watching Nicky move ahead. He turns and enters the next building, moving quickly to intercept her.
related_events: DESH arrives at the building steps and observes Nicky's movement
DESH anticipates Nicky's next move to cut her off
DESH enters the next building to intercept Nicky

name: Cronin Alerts Landy to Trap Set for Daniels in Tangier
description: Cronin walks down the hallway and enters the room where Landy is working at her desk. He tells her that Daniels' passport has been traced to a hotel in Tangier. Authorities are holding up a bank transfer Daniels made, keeping him in place, while an asset is being moved in from Casablanca.
related_events: Cronin informs Landy about tracking Daniels' passport to a hotel in Tangier
Authorities hold up a bank transfer to keep Daniels in place
Asset is moved in from Casablanca as part of coordinated operation

name: Bourne and Nicky Watch Desh's Deviation
description: Bourne and Nicky walk side by side, their attention fixed on a computer screen. On the display, Desh's icon moves along a path as he rides his scooter. Suddenly, the icon veers off its expected route, shifting direction without warning. The two pause, watching the screen as the change becomes clear.
related_events: Desh's icon deviates from course on computer screen
Desh rides his scooter
Bourne and Nicky walk together

name: Bourne Reacts to Desh's Still Position and Approaching Scooter Driver
description: Bourne looks at the computer screen and sees that Desh's icon has stopped moving. He glances up, scanning his surroundings. A scooter pulls up nearby, and the driver gets off, walking toward him.
related_events: Bourne recalculates and surveys his surroundings
Desh's location becomes stationary on computer screen
Scooter driver approaches Bourne

name: Bourne and Nicky Set Up a Meeting with Desh Bouksani
description: Bourne tells Nicky to arrange a meeting with Desh Bouksani, saying he has a new phone for him. Nicky warns that if they stop Desh, someone else will take his place. Bourne responds that they are not going to stop him—they are going to follow him. He believes Desh will lead them to Daniels.
related_events: Bourne instructs Nicky to arrange a meeting with Desh Bouksani
Nicky expresses concern that stopping Desh will lead to replacement
Bourne reveals plan to follow Desh to locate Daniels

name: Trace Confirmed, Signal Cut
description: A screen flickers to life amid the urgency of a technical operation. One technician announces a trace has been established on the target. Another confirms the target is moving north on Rue des Chretiens. An estimated time of interception is given as six minutes. Vosen responds immediately, ordering the cell signal blocked and the connection severed.
related_events: Screen activates during frantic technical operation
Technician reports successful trace on target
Second technician identifies target's direction and location
Technician provides estimated time of interception
Vosen orders cell signal blocked and connection severed

name: Desh Receives New Orders and the Bomb Is Ready
description: CU DESH receives a phone call from Nicky with new instructions: meet at the Tangier Cafe in Paris. Around the same time, the bomb is completed and sits on the work table.
related_events: CU DESH receives message to meet at Tangier Cafe in Paris
Nicky sends new routing information to CU DESH
Bomb is completed on the work table
related_occasions: Meeting At Tangier Cafe In Paris

name: Bourne's Escape Through the Alley
description: Bourne accelerated down the road, weaving through traffic. Three police cars surged out of a side street, barely missing him. He steered sharply into a narrow alleyway ahead. The squad cars behind him skidded to a stop, unable to follow.
related_events: Bourne accelerates to evade police pursuit
Three police cars emerge from a side road narrowly missing Bourne
Bourne selects and enters a narrow alleyway to escape
Police squad cars screech to a halt behind Bourne

name: Nicky Logs In and Finds Daniel's Location
description: Nicky sits at her computer and enters her user ID to log in. The screen displays a 3-D image of a hotel, with an icon marking Daniel's location. Bourne stands nearby, watching her the entire time.
related_events: Nicky logs in to her computer using her user ID
3-D image of hotel with Daniel's icon appears on monitor
Bourne observes Nicky at the computer

name: Vosen Orders Strike on Subject in Tangier
description: Landy and Cronin enter the hub as Vosen issues a kill order. He demands the subject's location. A technician reports that the subject is on foot and has entered Hotel Velazquez on Route Commerce in Tangier. Vosen orders an elevation and floor plan of the building, instructing the team to use a grid system to locate the exact room. He then directs the asset to target Daniels and requests the route between Daniels's hotel and the bank to plan an interception.
related_events: Vosen issues kill order during surveillance operation
Technician reports subject entering Hotel Velazquez in Tangier
Vosen requests building elevation and floor plan for tactical targeting
Vosen directs asset to target Daniels and plan interception route

name: Search for Neal Daniels and the Threat of an Operative
description: Nicky types on the computer and enters a search for Neal Daniels, but the system returns an access denied message. She observes that his location is being blocked. Bourne asks if she knows where Daniels is now that he's been found. Nicky responds that they will send one of their operatives to kill him. Bourne tells her to find out who the operative is.
related_events: Nicky searches for Neal Daniels and encounters access denial
Nicky deduces that Neal Daniels' location is being blocked
Bourne asks Nicky if he knows Neal Daniels' location after discovery
Nicky warns that an operative will be sent to terminate Neal Daniels
Bourne instructs Nicky to identify the operative assigned to terminate Daniels

name: Desh Takes the Phone and Moves Out
description: Nicky sits at the table when Desh walks up and snatches the phone. A scooter pulls up nearby, and the driver approaches Bourne, brushing past him to take the key. Keeping Desh in sight, the driver returns to the Vespa and pulls into traffic. On a computer screen, Desh's location icon begins moving again.
related_events: Desh snatches the phone from the table
Desh's location icon resumes movement on computer screen

name: Scooter Driver Takes Key and Leaves
description: A scooter driver pulls up and walks toward Bourne. He brushes past him, taking a key from him. Without pausing, the driver returns to his Vespa, starts it, and pulls into traffic. On a nearby screen, Desh's icon begins moving. A technician observes the screen and says, 'Sir, the asset is on the move, in route to subject.'
related_events: Scooter driver approaches and passes by Bourne
Scooter driver takes the key from Bourne
Scooter driver returns to Vespa and departs into traffic
Technician reports asset is on the move toward subject

name: Vosen Secures Room 117 and Initiates Communication Interception
description: Vosen asked if the room was ready. A technician responded that Room 117 was available. Vosen ordered the hotel's trunk line to be intercepted and all calls routed through the monitoring station with isolation enabled. On a computer screen, Desh's icon stopped moving.
related_events: Vosen inquires about room availability
Technician confirms Room 117 is ready
Vosen orders hotel trunk line interception

name: Desh Stops Moving, Technician Reports Material Acquisition
description: Desh's icon on the computer monitor comes to a halt. A technician speaks up, reporting that the asset has begun acquiring the materials.
related_events: Desh's icon stops moving on monitor
Technician reports asset acquiring materials

name: Bourne Arrives and Scans the Scene
description: Bourne arrives at the location and sees that Nicky is gone. Desh's Vespa is parked nearby. Police officers are on foot, moving through the area. The streets are crowded. Bourne looks around, taking in the scene, then glances up toward the rooftops. He begins running up a set of steps.
related_events: Bourne arrives and notices Nicky has left
Bourne sees Desh's Vespa parked nearby
Bourne observes additional police on foot
Bourne surveys the crowded streets

name: Bourne Seeks Higher Ground
description: Bourne parked his vehicle and scanned the crowded streets. He looked up to the rooftops, then began running up a set of steps.
related_events: Bourne parks his vehicle
Bourne looks up to the rooftops
Bourne starts running up steps to gain elevation

name: Bourne and Nicky Set Up in a Shabby Room
description: Bourne and Nicky enter a shabby room and flip on the fluorescent lights. The harsh glow reveals bare walls and minimal furnishings. Bourne drops his backpack onto the bed with a thud. Nicky walks to a small table, plugs her laptop into a USB port, and begins typing rapidly. Lines of code flash across the screen as she works, her focus unwavering.
related_events: Bourne and Nicky enter a shabby room and turn on the lights
Bourne throws his backpack onto the bed
Nicky connects her laptop and begins hacking into the Blackbriar system

name: Landy Seeks Kramer, Faces Denial
description: Pamela Landy picks up the phone and requests to speak with Kramer, emphasizing the urgency of the matter. Her call is relayed through an assistant to Kramer’s office, where the phone buzzes briefly before he instructs the assistant to say he is unreachable. The assistant informs Landy of the refusal. She hangs up the phone slowly, sits in silence for a moment, then rises and walks out of her office without a word.
related_events: Landy attempts to contact Kramer urgently
Kramer refuses to take Landy's call
Landy processes Kramer's refusal and prepares to take action

name: Nicky Answers Bourne's Call and Fleeing After Connection Fails
description: Nicky grabs her phone and answers the call. 'Bourne?' she says. 'Nicky? Listen to me. You need to—' The line cuts out. She stares at the screen, which now reads 'SERVICE DENIED.' She looks around quickly, then begins dismantling the phone, pulling it apart and scattering its components. Without hesitation, she gets up and starts moving across the square, leaving the area.
related_events: Nicky answers the phone call from Bourne
Phone call with Bourne is abruptly disconnected
Nicky sees 'SERVICE DENIED' on phone screen
Nicky becomes alarmed and decides to leave

name: Nicky Destroys Her Phone
description: Nicky grabbed the cell and answered. "Nicky?" Bourne's voice came through. "Listen to me. You need to—" The line cut out. She looked at the screen: 'SERVICE DENIED.' Her eyes darted around the square. Without hesitation, she took apart the phone, scattering its pieces. Then she moved quickly away.
related_events: Nicky dismantles her phone and scatters its components

name: Nicky Leaves the Square
description: Nicky grabbed the cell and answered. "Bourne?" she said. "Nicky?" came the reply. "Listen to me. You need to—" The line went dead. She looked at the screen: 'SERVICE DENIED'. She stared around, then quickly dismantled the phone, scattering its components. She began moving out of the square.
related_events: Nicky begins leaving the square

name: Bourne Breaks Free Amid Police Confrontation
description: Police officers surrounded Jason Bourne, demanding to see his papers. He spoke in Spanish, reaching for his identification, glancing up the street. More officers arrived, closing in. Bourne broke away suddenly, pushing through the crowd and darting into oncoming traffic. Three policemen moved to intercept, but he took them down and sprinted across the road. A boy on a moped was caught in the chaos. Bourne leapt onto the bike, kick-started it, and sped away into the traffic. Two squad cars turned in pursuit. As he weaved through traffic, one hand on the handlebars and the other on his phone, he tried desperately to call Nicky. The chase had begun.
related_events: Police surround Jason Bourne and demand identification
Additional police arrive at the confrontation scene
Jason Bourne breaks away from police confrontation
Jason Bourne evades police by sprinting across the road

name: Bourne Subdues Officers and Takes Moped to Escape
description: Bourne sprints through the crowded street as three policemen move to intercept him. With no way around, he takes them down and continues running. He spots a kid on a moped caught in the police dragnet. Bourne leaps onto the bike, kick-starts it, and speeds into traffic. Two squad cars turn and give chase as he weaves through the road, one hand on the handlebars, the other holding a phone, trying to make a call.
related_events: Jason Bourne takes down three approaching policemen
Jason Bourne commandeers a kid's moped during police dragnet

name: Bourne Flees on Moped While Trying to Call Nicky
description: Bourne speeds through traffic on a stolen moped, weaving between vehicles as two squad cars pursue. With one hand on the handlebars, he pulls out his cell phone and tries to make a call. The engine roars and tires screech around him, but he manages to get a dial tone as he races down the street.
related_events: Jason Bourne weaves through traffic on stolen moped
Jason Bourne attempts to call Nicky while fleeing on moped

name: Breach Detected: Nicky Parsons Traced
description: The team detects an unauthorized intrusion into their secure system. The breach is traced to a computer belonging to Nicky Parsons, with data transmission to the asset confirmed at 14:11. Around the same time, the asset briefly deviates from its course, moving south to Rue Belgique and stopping at Place de France. The location matches Parsons' known position. Vosen pieces together the connection, then orders the asset to target her once the current operation with Daniels concludes. Landy confronts Vosen, demanding to know the basis for the order, but Vosen insists Parsons has compromised the operation. He produces a document authorizing lethal action. Landy protests and leaves. Vosen instructs Bryan to send the kill order to the asset.
related_events: Unauthorized system breach by Nicky Parsons confirmed
Asset resumes original course after deviation
Vosen identifies connection between asset deviation and Nicky Parsons

name: Vosen Orders Nicky Parsons Targeted
description: After learning that information was sent to the asset from a computer belonging to Nicky Parsons, Vosen demands to know where the asset deviated. Lucy reports the stop at Place de France, confirming the location matches Parsons' whereabouts. Vosen orders that once Daniels is dealt with, the asset should be redirected to find her. Landy approaches him, insisting on knowing what he is doing. Vosen dismisses her, but she presses, questioning the basis of the operation. He states that Parsons has compromised a covert operation and is working with Jason Bourne. Landy argues that Vosen has no authority to kill her or Bourne, but Vosen slams a document on the desk—'Blackbriar: Lethal Action Protocol'—declaring his authority is legal and valid. As Landy protests that Parsons is one of their own and warns of the consequences, Vosen replies that it ends when they win. Landy turns and walks out. Vosen then instructs Bryan to notify the asset of the additional target. Bryan inputs a kill order for Nicky Parsons.
related_events: Vosen presents classified document to justify lethal action
Vosen asserts authority to authorize lethal action against Nicky Parsons and Jason Bourne
Landy confronts Vosen about continuation of operation targeting Nicky Parsons

name: Vosen Orders Nicky Parsons Targeted for Elimination
description: After dismissing Landy’s objections, Vosen turns to the operations team and instructs them to send the asset after Nicky Parsons once the Daniels operation is complete. Bryan acknowledges the order and enters a formal kill directive for Parsons into the system, marking her as a target.
related_events: Vosen orders asset to pursue Nicky Parsons after Daniels operation
Vosen orders asset to target Nicky Parsons for elimination
Bryan inputs kill order for Nicky Parsons into system

name: Nicky Spots Desh and Begins to Evade
description: Nicky walks quickly down the Rue des Chretiens, her pace steady as she takes in the unusually high number of police in the area. She stops suddenly, spotting Desh in the distance. The moment she sees him, she turns and moves fast, slipping into a narrow alleyway. She scans the side streets and rooftops, then climbs a short flight of steps and disappears into a riad, staying out of sight. Desh continues forward, following her trail.
related_events: Nicky walks quickly through Rue des Chretiens noticing increased police presence
Nicky spots Desh and realizes he is pursuing her

name: Nicky Evades Desh in the Rue des Chretiens
description: Nicky walks quickly along the Rue des Chretiens, then stops abruptly when she sees Desh approaching. She turns and moves swiftly into the narrow alleyways, slipping out of sight. She glances toward the rooftops, then climbs a set of steps leading into a riad. Desh follows, tracking her movements.
related_events: Nicky employs Treadstone tactics to evade detection
Nicky gains tactical advantage by looking toward rooftops

name: Nicky Enters Riad to Evade Desh
description: Nicky quickens her pace up a set of steps and slips inside a riad, disappearing from view. The moment she crosses the threshold, the street noise fades, and the narrow courtyard swallows her silhouette. Behind her, Desh continues down the Rue des Chretiens, scanning the alleys, his path now severed from hers.
related_events: Nicky ascends steps and enters a riad to escape

name: Desh Tracks Nicky Through the City
description: Nicky moves quickly along the Rue des Chretiens, glancing at alleyways and slipping out of sight. She climbs steps into a riad, moving toward the rooftops to gain the upper hand. Desh follows, tracing her path through the narrow streets and enclosed passages, staying close behind.
related_events: Desh tracks Nicky's movements through the area

name: Vosen Orders Bourne's Elimination
description: After a tense silence, Landy walks out of Vosen's office. Vosen picks up the phone and issues a standing kill order for Jason Bourne. He calls Kramer to report that Bourne has been lost. Kramer asks if Vosen still believes Bourne is after Daniels. Vosen confirms it, saying Nicky is just the means and that finding Daniels will lead them to Bourne. Kramer warns that Daniels knows too much and they cannot let the two meet. Vosen says he will handle it. Kramer tells him to inform Hirsch, just in case.
related_events: Landy exits Vosen's office after tense confrontation
Vosen issues standing kill order for Jason Bourne
Vosen reports loss of Jason Bourne to Kramer

name: Vosen and Kramer Respond to Bourne's Pursuit of Daniels
description: Vosen stands in his office at night, speaking on the phone with Kramer. He tells Kramer they have lost Bourne. Kramer asks if Vosen still believes Bourne is after Daniels. Vosen confirms it, saying that Nicky is only a means to that end, and that finding Daniels will lead them to Bourne. Kramer warns that Daniels knows too much—everything—and that they cannot allow the two to meet. Vosen says he will handle it. Kramer agrees, then adds that Vosen should inform Hirsch, just in case. Vosen ends the call.
related_events: Kramer expresses concern about Bourne locating Daniels
Vosen decides to locate Daniels to find Bourne
Kramer instructs Vosen to inform Hirsch as contingency

name: Bourne and Nicky at the Truck Stop in Spain
description: At a truck stop in Spain, Bourne and Nicky sit across from each other, drinking coffee in silence. Bourne places a photograph on the table showing Daniels and Hirsch. Nicky identifies Daniels and says she does not recognize the other man. Bourne says the man may have started Treadstone and remembers Daniels bringing him to meet him. As he speaks, Bourne flashes back to a moment of being held underwater with a sack over his head, struggling to breathe. He returns to the present, quiet. Nicky tells him the ordeal wasn't a one-time event—that they subjected him to it repeatedly. Bourne looks at her, then asks why she is helping him. Nicky says it was difficult for her being involved with him. Bourne says he remembers nothing. Two Spanish police officers enter the café. Bourne and Nicky stand and leave.
related_events: Bourne shows photo of Daniels and Hirsch to Nicky
Bourne recalls being introduced to Hirsch by Daniels
Bourne experiences flashback of underwater initiation

name: Bourne and Nicky Flee the Truck Stop
description: Bourne and Nicky sit in a truck stop in Spain, speaking quietly over coffee. Bourne shows her a photograph of Daniels and Hirsch, asking if she recognizes them. She identifies Daniels but not the other man. Bourne recalls fragments of his past, describing a memory of being held underwater. Nicky reveals that the treatment was not a one-time event, but something repeated. Before she can say more, two Spanish police officers enter the café. Bourne and Nicky stand and leave without another word.
related_events: Bourne and Nicky leave truck stop upon arrival of Spanish police

name: Landy Confronts Vosen Over Lethal Orders
description: Landy pushes open the door to Vosen's office without knocking. She strides in and immediately demands to know when Vosen gained authorization to carry out lethal action against Daniels. Vosen responds sharply, reminding her that Daniels had emptied a Blackbriar safe and escaped to Morocco. Landy insists they should simply apprehend him, but Vosen argues he lacks the personnel on the ground and cannot risk the file falling into the wrong hands. Landy presses him on what Daniels actually possesses. Vosen explains that Daniels oversaw all of Blackbriar’s operations across Southern Europe and North Africa. Landy counters that the world already knows about their rendition and lethal capabilities. Vosen insists the danger is greater—Daniels has the entire playbook: names, dates, locations of ghost sites, and details on asset training. He pulls a file from his safe labeled 'Blackbriar: Lethal Action Protocol' and holds it up. Landy opens it and reads the line authorizing instantaneous lethal action. She looks at him, stunned. 'You just decide?' she asks. 'No oversight? No checks?' Vosen tells her to open her eyes to the threat. He says they can't afford to be tied down by bureaucracy anymore.
related_events: Landy enters Vosen's office without knocking
Vosen questions Landy's authorization for lethal action against Daniels

name: Vosen Reveals Daniels' Escape and Intelligence Threat
description: Landy enters the room without knocking. Vosen tells her that Daniels has stolen contents from a Blackbriar safe and fled to Morocco. He explains that Daniels ran Blackbriar's operations in Southern Europe and North Africa. Landy questions whether Vosen has authorization to take lethal action against Daniels. Vosen insists the intelligence Daniels possesses is highly sensitive, including operational names, dates, secret detention sites, and asset training methods. He produces a file labeled 'Blackbriar: Lethal Action Protocol' and shows it to Landy, pointing to a section authorizing immediate lethal action. Landy flips through the document, reading the authorization clause, and expresses disbelief that Vosen can make such decisions without oversight. Vosen argues that the threat is too urgent to wait for bureaucratic approval.
related_events: Vosen reveals Daniels fled to Morocco after robbing a Blackbriar safe
Vosen discloses Daniels' role in Blackbriar operations across Southern Europe and North Africa

name: Landy and Vosen Disagree on Handling Daniels
description: Landy enters without knocking and demands to know when Vosen gained authorization for lethal action against Daniels. Vosen responds that Daniels fled to Morocco after emptying a Blackbriar safe. Landy insists they should capture him, but Vosen says he doesn’t have personnel on the ground to carry out the operation. He explains that his priority is preventing the file from falling into the wrong hands. Landy presses him on what Daniels has, and Vosen reveals that Daniels oversaw all of Blackbriar’s operations in Southern Europe and North Africa. Vosen emphasizes that Daniels possesses sensitive information, including names, dates, ghost sites, and training protocols. He produces a file labeled 'Blackbriar: Lethal Action Protocol' and asserts that he has the authority to use lethal force without oversight. Landy opens the file and reads the authorization for instantaneous lethal action. She challenges Vosen, asking if he alone makes the decision, with no checks or balances. Vosen insists the threat is too great to be slowed by bureaucracy.
related_events: Landy urges Vosen to capture Daniels
Vosen states inability to deploy personnel in Morocco

name: Landy Confronts Vosen Over Daniels and Blackbriar's Authority
description: Landy enters the room without knocking and demands to know when Vosen gained authorization for lethal action against Daniels. Vosen responds that the authorization came after Daniels emptied a Blackbriar safe and fled to Morocco. Landy suggests they simply apprehend him, but Vosen insists he lacks personnel on the ground and cannot risk the file falling into the wrong hands. Landy asks what information Daniels has taken. Vosen explains that Daniels oversaw all of Blackbriar’s operations in Southern Europe and North Africa. Landy counters that the world already knows about rendition and lethal capabilities. Vosen insists the file contains the full playbook—names, dates, ghost sites, and asset training methods. Landy states that Vosen does not have the authority to order a killing. Vosen replies that he does, producing a file labeled 'Blackbriar: Lethal Action Protocol.' He opens it to a section stating that instantaneous lethal action is authorized under certain conditions. Landy asks if Vosen can make such decisions alone, with no oversight. Vosen argues that the threat is too real and they can no longer afford delays caused by bureaucratic approval.
related_events: Landy questions what information Daniels possesses
Landy challenges the significance of exposing rendition and lethal action capabilities

name: Vosen Shows Landy the Lethal Action Protocol
description: Landy enters the room without knocking and confronts Vosen about authorizing lethal action against Daniels. Vosen explains that Daniels fled to Morocco after taking a Blackbriar safe, and that he has no personnel on the ground to capture him without risking the file falling into the wrong hands. Landy demands to know what Daniels has, and Vosen replies that he ran Blackbriar operations in Southern Europe and North Africa and possesses sensitive information, including names, dates, ghost sites, and training methods. Landy insists Vosen lacks authority to kill Daniels, but Vosen produces a file labeled 'Blackbriar: Lethal Action Protocol' and holds it up. Landy opens it and reads the directive inside authorizing instantaneous lethal action without oversight. She questions whether Vosen can make such decisions alone, with no checks or balances. Vosen argues that the threat is too real and that they can no longer afford to be tied up by bureaucracy.
related_events: Vosen presents Blackbriar Lethal Action Protocol file to Landy
Landy reads authorization for instantaneous lethal action in the file
Vosen justifies absence of oversight in lethal operations

name: Bourne Follows Desh to the Corner
description: Desh parks his motorbike and walks around a corner. Bourne follows on foot, moving carefully behind him.
related_events: Desh parks motorbike and walks around corner
Bourne follows Desh on foot

name: Bourne Sees Daniels' Car and Reacts to the Threat
description: Bourne stands on the street as Daniels' car comes down the road. He sees the vehicle approaching and immediately stops, recognizing the danger. His attention shifts back to Desh, who is now holding a detonator. Bourne locks eyes with him just as the explosion occurs.
related_events: Daniels' car approaches down the street
Bourne recognizes imminent danger from approaching car

name: Bourne and Desh: The Detonation
description: Bourne turns and sees Desh standing with the detonator in his hand. Their eyes meet. In the next instant, Desh triggers the device. The explosion erupts, hurling Bourne across the street. He lands motionless on the pavement. Desh looks back and sees Bourne lying still. He mounts his motorbike and rides away.
related_events: Bourne sees Desh holding detonator
Bourne and Desh lock eyes
Desh detonates explosive device

name: Explosion Kills Daniels, Bourne Thrown and Lying Unconscious
description: The explosion rips through the street, killing Daniels instantly. The force of the blast hurls Bourne across the pavement, where he lands motionless. Desh looks back and sees Bourne lying still. He mounts his motorbike and rides away toward Nicky.
related_events: Explosion kills Daniels instantly
Bourne is thrown across street by blast force
Bourne lies motionless in street after explosion

name: Desh Confirms Bourne's Collapse and Rides Toward Nicky
description: Desh turns and sees Bourne lying motionless in the street after the explosion. He mounts the motorbike, rides around the corner, and drives away in the direction of his next target, Nicky.
related_events: Desh observes Bourne's motionless body
Desh departs on motorbike to target Nicky

name: Bourne Ascends a Riad to Pursue Desh Across the Rooftops
description: Bourne enters a riad and moves quickly through its courtyard. He climbs a series of stairs, then ascends a ladder, emerging onto the rooftops. From this vantage point, he scans the skyline. In the distance, he spots Nicky walking slowly ahead, with Desh moving quickly behind her. Bourne begins to follow, closing the gap between them.
related_events: Bourne enters a riad and ascends to the rooftops

name: Bourne Spots Nicky and Desh, Begins Rooftop Pursuit
description: From the rooftops, Bourne scans the skyline and sees Nicky walking slowly down a narrow street, with Desh following closely behind. Desh moves quickly, unnoticed by the crowds below. Bourne begins chasing him, leaping across rooftops, descending into a riad, cutting through an alley, and climbing back up via a ladder. He gains ground, staying just behind Desh, who now climbs onto the rooftops as well. Desh readies his gun with a silencer and increases his pace. Bourne sees Nicky below, still in the crowd, unaware. He pushes forward, closing the distance between them as both assassins move silently across the rooftops, the police below oblivious to the chase above.
related_events: Bourne spots Nicky and Desh in the distance
Bourne tails Desh across multiple rooftops
Bourne closes in on Desh during rooftop chase

name: Desh Readies His Weapon and Closes In on Nicky
description: Desh moves across the rooftops, attaching a silencer to his gun. He spots Nicky walking through the crowd below and begins moving faster, advancing steadily toward his target.
related_events: Desh prepares his gun with a silencer
Desh speeds up while targeting Nicky

name: Bourne and Desh Chase Across Rooftops
description: Bourne and Desh race across the rooftops, leaping silently between buildings over narrow streets. Below, police search alleyways, unaware of the chase unfolding above. Bourne gains ground, closing the distance between them as both men move swiftly and deliberately through the maze of rooftops and stairways.
related_events: Two assassins leap across narrow streets above oblivious police

name: Bourne Chases Desh Through the Streets and Courtyards
description: Desh descends into the street and disappears into the crowd, moving quickly to avoid the police. Bourne follows, rushing down a series of stairs, through a narrow corridor, and across a courtyard. He bursts through a door into the street, scanning the area. The path ahead is blocked by a police checkpoint, forcing him to veer sharply onto a different route. Desh is no longer in sight.
related_events: Bourne pursues Desh through stairs, corridor, and courtyard
Desh descends into the street and evades police by blending into crowds

name: Bourne Loses Desh at Police Checkpoint
description: Bourne bursts through a door into the street, only to find a police checkpoint blocking his path. He veers sharply, taking a diagonal route to avoid it. As he ducks down a side passage, Desh vanishes from sight. The crowds shift, obscuring any trace of him. Bourne is alone in the maze, Desh gone—for now.
related_events: Bourne encounters a police checkpoint and changes direction
Bourne temporarily loses track of Desh
